# Keyboard shortcuts

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask shortcuts` from the command registry (`ui.menu.list`). Do not edit by hand. -->

The default (Classic) keymap. `Cmd` is ⌘ on macOS and `Ctrl` on Linux, Windows and the web; `Alt` is ⌥.
Change any binding in Help → Keyboard Shortcuts (or `app.setShortcut`); Settings switches to the
Alternative keymap set. Keys that work without a menu item (ratings `0`–`5`, labels `6`–`9`,
`[`/`]` rating steps, `Shift` + key to advance) are listed in [library-shortcuts.md](../library-shortcuts.md).
